spans.s:
m. (-कः)
1 A kisser, a lecher.
2 A rogue, a cheat.
3 The loadstone.
4 A general scholar, one who knows parts in a variety of books.
5 The upper part or middle of a balance.
E.
चुबि to kiss, affix क्वुन्.

mfn. (म्बन्-म्बन्ती-म्बत्)
Kissing.
E.
चुवि to kiss, शतृ aff.

A kiss.
E.
चुबि to kiss, affix ल्युट्.

n. (-नं)
Kissing.
E.
चुम्बन, and दान giving.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Kissed.
E.
चुवि to kiss, क्त aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Kissing.
E.
चुवि, and क्तवतु aff.
